title: Align Tactile Frames with Robot Actions
summary: A frame must be paired with a command that was already active when the image was captured.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Image intensities and normalized commands are dimensionless. Image coordinates use integer pixel centers with x right and y down. Time is seconds except explicitly microsecond exposure metadata.

physical_contract.axes: Capture, image row/column/channel, action and candidate axes defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: One sensor and aligned optical calibration; action timestamps share the sensor clock. No implicit clock or physical-frame conversion.
physical_contract.batching: Capture, image row/column/channel, action and candidate axes defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original operational or vision diagnostic motivated by DIGIT. It is not the paper's reconstruction/controller implementation, calibrated force, or proof of contact safety.
